stories.headline: EU-African Union Summit Concludes with Landmark Green Energy Partnership
stories.summary: Leaders agreed on a multi-billion euro initiative to boost renewable energy infrastructure across Africa. This aims to accelerate sustainable development and combat climate change.

stories.headline: Asian Tech Giant Unveils AI Chip Designed for Extreme Energy Efficiency
stories.summary: The new chip promises significantly reduced power consumption for large AI models, addressing critical sustainability concerns. It could set a new industry standard.

stories.headline: North American Trade Bloc Finalizes Digital Economy Pact
stories.summary: US, Canada, and Mexico signed an agreement standardizing digital trade rules and data privacy. It aims to boost cross-border e-commerce and innovation.

stories.headline: Promising Phase 3 Trial Results for Novel Alzheimer's Treatment Announced
stories.summary: A new drug showed significant cognitive decline reduction in late-stage trials, offering hope for millions. Regulatory approval is expected within months.

stories.headline: UN Warns of Worsening Humanitarian Crisis in Sahel Region
stories.summary: Drought and ongoing conflict have exacerbated food insecurity and displacement, leaving millions in urgent need of aid. International response is critical.
